svg.title: Vertical W: interfaces and mass-point interpolation
svg.desc: A column has lower interface coordinate 0 metres with W equal to 0 metres per second, upper interface coordinate 10 metres with W equal to 2, and mass coordinate 5 metres with interpolated W equal to 1. Coordinates and compatible auxiliaries must also describe the new locations. This is not a constant-altitude grid.

g.text: Vertical W in one model column
Markers show locations — not vertical flow
Upper interface: 10 m, W = 2 m s⁻¹
Mass point: 5 m, W = 1 m s⁻¹
Lower interface: 0 m, W = 0 m s⁻¹
Linear interpolation uses native coordinates; transform compatible auxiliaries too.
Illustrative model coordinates, not fixed geometric altitudes or a constant-altitude grid.
